Outside LIMIT dispositions: O001–O004 upheld as LIMIT-NOT-NEW-GUARD; overlaps/reading contacts are accurately flagged, but do not create new distractor guards absent a direct pair. In particular 帰/戻, 場/席/所, 処/所, and 戦/試 match contacts remain explicit scope cautions.
Findings: Medium; C1/C3; kanji/成.md front-matter title and H1: «совершаться» can suggest occurring/being carried out rather than 成る «становиться/получаться» and 成す «достигать результата/совершать», so learners may mislearn the basic sense. Change the second gloss to «достигать результата» (or similarly distinguish accomplishment from becoming). Evidence: captured KanjiPedia defines なる／できあがる, なす／なしとげる and そだつ; KANJIDIC2 lists become/turn into/reach/accomplish/grow; JMdict 1375610 and 1375690. Confidence: medium-high.
Optional: 戦 title could add «состязание», since the body and sources teach that sense; «битва; сражение» remains a sound core gloss, so this is optional completeness, not a confirmed defect.
Limits: No active quiz UI/generator behavior was examined; pair dispositions are limited to actual pool titles and captured official senses. No tests/builds/validators run as instructed. No other assigned scope is outstanding; no external web pages were read.
